_comment: The lifecycle of a market variant (ADR-032, capability 9). A separate model from config/lifecycle/label-states.json because a translation is reviewed for different things by different people: linguistic review asks whether the translation says what the source says, which is not what an approver of the source was asked. Note that this file adds a whole review process to the platform without a line of code - which is what config-as-data is for (ADR-012, capability 21). The approve gate is segregated from the author, and for a variant the author is the translator, so CAP-LOC-007's segregation of translator from approver falls out of the mechanism that already segregates author from approver.
name: variant
